# Little Kit

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Kit has curling red hair, fine nose, and dimples in his elbows like his mother, paired with his father's steady, humorous mouth and open hazel eyes. He is the only child in his family with ears pleasant enough to satisfy Tabitha. His overall appearance is described as particularly pleasing.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P21](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0021)_

## Personality

Kit is a solid, dependable boy who never breaks a promise and speaks sparingly. He is skeptical by nature, preferring to personally test assertions for scientific truth rather than taking them on trust. Protective of others and highly regarded as the squarest boy in Glen St. Agnes, he can handle troublesome companions like Mary Stubbs easily. Unlike his brother Edmund, he takes pleasure in occasional brawls and mock fights.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c7 P31](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0031), [v5 c11 P7](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0007), [v5 c11 P8](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0008), [v5 c16 P25](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0025), [v5 c23 P66](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0066)_

## History

Kit Carrow was born at the small house beside the harbour coast as the child of the House of Dreams. As an infant, his mother Nell broke a strict pact with Hugh to avoid baby talk upon holding him for the first time, and she persisted in calling him Little Kit—a habit continued by Tabitha that Kit grew to detest by age thirteen. He grew up deeply attached to Fern Hollow, hanging sleigh-bells on the tangled Tree Lovers trees and frequently foraging and fishing there. He gained a reputation at school as a chieftain who engaged in sports and fights, contrasting with his brother Edmund. While visiting Grey Shutters, he became the most cherished child of Aunt Thirza. Later, he showed Mary Stubbs his inherited collection of oddities in the Hollowmere attic and showed great competence in handling her outbursts. As he matured, he began preparing for the entrance examination for Regent's Academy by staying after school and studying in the garret, gradually spending less evening time in Fern Hollow. Prior to leaving for Port Marlow to attend the Academy, he shared a final evening gathering in Fern Hollow with his companions and expressed a deep yearning to become a famous soldier and general.

_Sources: [v4 c36 P32](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0032), [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c3 P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c6 P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029), [v5 c11 P8](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0008), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049), [v5 c26 P25](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0025), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)_
